documents.content:
Customer refunds

A duplicate charge may be refunded immediately after transaction verification. Service dissatisfaction claims require a support review within seven calendar days. Refunds return to the original payment method; agents cannot redirect funds to another account.

Order cancellation

A customer may cancel before warehouse picking begins. Once picking starts, the order follows the return process instead. Personalized products cannot be cancelled after production has started.

Return shipping

The company provides a prepaid label for damaged or incorrect products. Change-of-mind returns use customer-paid shipping. Returned goods must be scanned by the carrier within fourteen days of authorization.

Account recovery

Recovery begins with a verified email link. If email access is unavailable, support verifies two non-secret account facts and escalates to identity review. Support must never ask for a password or a complete payment card number.

Subscription changes

An upgrade takes effect immediately and charges the prorated difference. A downgrade starts at the next billing cycle. Cancellation disables renewal but preserves paid access until the current period ends.

Invoice corrections

A legal name or billing address may be corrected within thirty days of issue. Tax identifiers cannot be replaced after an invoice is finalized; finance must issue a credit note and a new invoice.

Customer data export

A verified account owner can request a machine-readable export. The export is prepared within seventy-two hours and its download link expires after twenty-four hours. Internal fraud signals and other customers' records are excluded.

Account deletion

Deletion requests enter a fourteen-day cooling-off period. Active disputes or statutory accounting records may be retained under a legal hold. At the end of the hold, identifiers are erased or irreversibly anonymized.

Support escalation

Safety incidents and suspected account takeover go directly to the priority response queue. Billing questions move to finance only after support collects the invoice number. Ordinary product questions remain with first-line support.

Product warranty

Hardware is covered for manufacturing defects for two years from delivery. Accidental damage, normal wear and unauthorized repairs are excluded. A replacement does not restart the original warranty period.

Delivery exceptions

A parcel marked delivered but missing is investigated after the customer checks the address and nearby safe locations. International customs delays do not qualify for an automatic refund. A carrier loss confirmation allows reshipment or refund.

Merchant disputes

A merchant has ten business days to submit fulfillment evidence. Evidence may include carrier acceptance and customer communication, but must not include unrelated customer records. Missing the deadline closes the dispute in the customer's favor.

Accessible support

Customers may request large-print documents or a text-only communication channel. A representative may join with the customer's explicit consent. Accessibility requests do not require disclosure of a medical diagnosis.

促销与优惠券规则

每笔订单只能使用一个百分比优惠券，但可以同时使用免邮权益。已经过期的优惠券不能延期。退款金额按实际支付金额计算，不返还已经使用的单次优惠券。

礼品卡规则

礼品卡余额不能兑换现金，也不能用于购买新的礼品卡。退回使用礼品卡支付的商品时，相应金额退回原礼品卡。礼品卡遗失后，只有在能提供购买凭证时才可补发。

Privacy request routing

Requests to access, correct or delete personal data use the privacy portal. General support cannot verify legal identity for these requests. This document does not name an individual privacy officer or provide a direct telephone number.
